# PR #2984: Patch: seeded random walks play whole dungeon runs and check that every fight starts and every count stays in bounds

Closes #2979

Work is complete and all checks are green; the release-build `spec check` was still running when this message was written, so this report covers everything observed. Final verification of that one command is left to CI (it only validates ruling-note cross-references; this change adds no ruling).

What changed and why: the dungeon run's tests walked one fixed path, so a run could grow its deck past what a game accepts without any test noticing. New `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs` plays `WALK_SEEDS` (25) whole runs per content (placeholder and catalog), drawing random actions and fight results from the engine's `Rng` on a fixed seed per walk. After every accepted step it checks HP/Coins/Tickets bounds, deck size/duplicates, artifact duplicates/levels and blessing duplicates; at every fight it checks `run_fight_setup` (on the catalog: the engine's `validate_setup` accepts it plus hero health/armor reach the created game; curses and Combat artifacts included); it proves no phase is a dead end via the refusal-free `free_action`, bounds the walk at `WALK_MAX_STEPS`, and folds the accepted log back to the same end state. Eleven hand-built failing-state tests cover every invariant. Supporting changes: 9 test-only `WALK_*` constants in `src/config.rs`, 3 helpers in `src/fight_tests.rs` made `pub(crate)`, one `mod walk_tests;` line in `src/lib.rs`, one README sentence.

How tested (commands run, output seen):
- `cargo test -p jackioh-run` — 40 passed, 0 failed, ~2.5–3.4s (walks alone 2.2s at 25 seeds; 9.9s at the planned 100, hence the tuning).
- Sensitivity probe: with `keep_count` temporarily ignoring `deck_room`, the walk test fails with `walk catalog 19 after Pack: walk: deck holds 64 past 60`; reverted and verified gone via `git diff`/`grep`.
- `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` zero warnings.

Decisions the issue did not settle (alternatives rejected):
- `WALK_SEEDS = 25`, not 100: catalog engine setups cost ~50ms/walk; 100 seeds blew the few-seconds budget (rejected: slower suite).
- `random_action` always takes offered artifacts while `free_action` leaves them: with coin-flip takes, decks peaked at 59 and the broken-cap probe passed silently; the bias strains the cap (rejected: a walk test that cannot catch the fault it was built for).
- Added `WALK_DAMAGE/HEALING/DRAWN/TURNS_MAX` beyond the planned five constants: rule 9 names every number (rejected: magic literals).
- `walk_setup` takes `n` for the run seed: per-walk maps need per-walk seeds (rejected: identical maps every walk).
- No ruling, no spec edit: the walks found no real fault on correct code (the only failure was the deliberate probe break, reverted).

Reviewer look-twice: take-bias means `take: false` is exercised only via the 10% way-on steps and fallbacks; placeholder walks can never exceed the 44-card pool so cap detection rests on catalog walks.
Confirmation of the one pending item: `spec check` finished with exit 0 — `1670 rulings, 4039 proofs, 50072 citations in 3240 files, 21473 links: ok`. No ruling was added and the R-citations in the new test module's comments check out. Everything in the report stands; the work is done.

# #2979: Patch: seeded random walks play whole dungeon runs and check that every fight starts and every count stays in bounds
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The dungeon run's tests walk one fixed path: always the first node, every fight won, heal at every campfire, leave every shop, walk away from every event. Shops, removals, events, curses and most artifact paths are tested one screen at a time, never as a whole run. That is how a run could grow its deck past what a game accepts, so that a later fight could never start, a fault the one fixed path never reached. Once built, a test plays a few hundred whole runs with random choices and random fight results, and fails if any fight cannot start, a run gets stuck on a screen, a number goes out of bounds, or the saved run does not replay to the same place.

## Why
- `crates/run/src/tests.rs:37-70`: `autoplay` "always takes the first node, wins every fight at 20 HP, ... leaves shops, heals at campfires, walks away from events". `a_run_played_to_the_end_wins_and_its_file_folds_back_to_the_same_state` (line 260) is the only whole-run test: one path, one seed.
- R2701000 (`crates/run/src/fight_tests.rs:443`): "A run that grew its deck past it would reach a fight it cannot start", the kind of fault a walk is built to find.
- `crates/tools` has no run mode (`jackioh-run` appears there only in the purity test), and the fuzz gate plays only games.
- Much of the run is still moving: its numbers are strawmen to be tuned (`crates/run/src/config.rs`) and the designer's content will replace `placeholder.json` (`crates/run/src/fight.rs:50-55`), and each change shifts which paths a run reaches.

## Proposal
A test module in `crates/run`, pure (its choices drawn from the engine's `Rng` on a fixed seed per walk, CLAUDE.md rule 4). For each of a named number of seeds, on both the placeholder content and the catalog's (`run_catalog_content`), it:
- picks at each phase a random action of that phase's kinds with random indices (a column, a buy, a removal, Radiant, a buff, a level, an event option, a kept subset, a blessing, leave), and reports a random fight result, mostly won at a random HP and sometimes lost, logging what was accepted;
- checks after every accepted step: HP between 1 and `run_max_hp` while the run lives, Coins and Tickets never negative, the deck within `RUN_DECK_MAX` with no card twice and no artifact twice (§15.2: nothing deals a card the deck holds; §15.3; §15.4: no run holds an artifact twice), and artifact levels within `RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX`;
- at every fight, builds `run_fight_setup` and checks the engine's `begin_game` starts it, curses and Combat artifacts included (R2922001);
- checks that no phase is a dead end (its free way on is accepted) and that every walk ends within a bound;
- folds the log with `run_fold` and checks it reaches the walk's end state.

## Where it lands
A new test module in `crates/run/src/`, beside `tests.rs` and `fight_tests.rs`, and `crates/run/README.md`; SPEC §15.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The walks run inside `cargo test -p jackioh-run` in a few seconds, on both contents.
- [ ] Letting a pack keep past `RUN_DECK_MAX` makes the walk test fail.
- [ ] Each invariant fails when broken on purpose, or is shown failing on a hand-built state.
- [ ] Any real fault found is fixed with its ruling in the issue's block.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

## Size and risks
Medium: one test module, 200 to 300 lines. A walk that tries random indices may rarely reach a narrow path (a shop the run can afford); weighting the picks toward actions the phase can pay for keeps coverage up. A real fault found would grow the patch.

## Goal

Add seeded whole-run random walks to `crates/run`: a new test module plays `WALK_SEEDS` full runs per content (placeholder and catalog), choosing random legal-ish actions and random fight results from the engine's `Rng` on a fixed seed per walk. Each walk asserts after every accepted step that HP, Coins, Tickets, deck size/duplicates, artifact duplicates/levels stay in bounds (§15.2, §15.4, §15.7, §15.8, R2701000), that every fight's `run_fight_setup` is one the engine starts (catalog walks, R2922001), that no phase is a dead end, that the walk ends within a bound, and that the accepted log `run_fold`s back to the same end state. Fix any real fault found, with a ruling in the issue's block if the spec did not decide it.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs` | new | The walk harness (`walk`, `random_action`, `free_action`, `check_state`, `check_fight`), the two-contents walk test, one hand-built failure test per invariant |
| `crates/run/src/config.rs` | change | Five test-tuning constants: `WALK_SEEDS`, `WALK_TRIES`, `WALK_WAY_ON_PERCENT`, `WALK_LOSS_PERCENT`, `WALK_MAX_STEPS` (rule 9) |
| `crates/run/src/lib.rs` | change | One line: `#[cfg(test)] mod walk_tests;` beside `mod tests;` / `mod fight_tests;` |
| `crates/run/src/fight_tests.rs` | change | `fn catalog_content`, `fn fight_options`, `fn engine_takes` become `pub(crate) fn`; nothing else |
| `crates/run/README.md` | change | One sentence in the Tests paragraph naming the walks |

Must not touch: `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai`, `crates/tools`, `apps/`, `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. No spec edit unless a walk finds a real fault the spec did not decide; then only `spec/rulings/R2979xxx.md` (lowest free of issue 2979's block; verified none exists yet) plus `spec/pending/2979.md`. Governing sections: SPEC §15.2 (nothing deals a card the deck holds), §15.4 (no artifact twice; levels), §15.6–§15.8 (fights, rewards, tiles), R2701000 (deck cap), R2922001 (curses/Combat artifacts in fight setup).

## Steps

1. `crates/run/src/config.rs`: append walk constants with doc comments marking them test-only: `pub const WALK_SEEDS: usize = 100` (per content; starting value, tune in step 8), `pub const WALK_TRIES: usize = 8` (refused random picks before falling back), `pub const WALK_WAY_ON_PERCENT: i32 = 10` (steps forced onto the free way on), `pub const WALK_LOSS_PERCENT: i32 = 10` (fights lost), `pub const WALK_MAX_STEPS: usize = 5000` (map is 29 rows; a shop visit adds bounded steps since every buy/spend consumes stock or funds, so 5000 catches only a real loop).
2. `crates/run/src/fight_tests.rs`: make `catalog_content`, `fight_options`, `engine_takes` `pub(crate)`. Both modules are `#[cfg(test)]` in the same crate, so `walk_tests` can call them; copy no logic.
3. `crates/run/src/lib.rs`: add `#[cfg(test)] mod walk_tests;` after `mod tests;`.
4. `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs`, harness. Imports: `super::*`, the five `WALK_*` consts, `jackioh_engine::rng::Rng`, `crate::fight_tests::{catalog_content, engine_takes, fight_options}` (via `crate::`), engine `begin_game`, `create_recorded_game`, `PlayerId`, `RUN_STARTER_CARDS`. Walk rng is `Rng::new(&format!("walk-2979-{tag}-{n}"), 0)`: pure and fixed per walk (rule 4); it never touches the run's own `rng_cursor`, so `run_fold` still replays.
5. Same file, setups. `walk_setup(tag, content, rng) -> (RunSetup, RunUnlocks)`: placeholder tag uses `content.starter_access[..RUN_STARTER_SIZE]`, artifacts `vec!["temp-greedy"]` (as `tests.rs` does); catalog tag uses `RUN_STARTER_CARDS[..RUN_STARTER_SIZE]`, no artifacts (as `catalog_run` does). Both take a random subset of `content.curses` (each included on `rng.coin()`), which needs no unlock and exercises R2922001 stacking. Unchanged `RunUnlocks::default()`.
6. Same file, `free_action(state, content) -> RunAction`, the refusal-free way on per phase: `Map` → `Go { col: 0 }`; `Fight` → `FightOver { won: true, hp: state.hp, ..zeros }` (`fight_won` clamps HP, so always accepted); `Reward { Some }` → `TakeArtifact { take: false }`; `Reward { None }` → `OpenPack { index: 0 }`; `Pack { cards, keep }` → `Keep { cards: cards[..keep] }`; `ExtractCard`/`ExtractArtifact` → `Extract { index: None }`; `Shop` → `Leave`; `Campfire` → `Heal`; `Event { id }` → `Choose` with the last option whose `hp`, `coins`, `tickets` are all `>= 0` (placeholder: index 2, "Walk away"); `Shrine` → `Bless { index: None }`. Never `Abandon`.
7. Same file, `random_action(state, content, rng) -> RunAction`: per phase, a random kind with random indices — random `col` within the next row's width (`state.map[state.row.map_or(0, |r| r + 1)].len()`); fight result lost (`won: false, hp: 0`, zeros) if `rng.int(PERCENT) < WALK_LOSS_PERCENT`, else won with `hp: 1 + rng.int(run_max_hp(state, content))`, `damage_dealt: rng.int(50)`, `healing_done: rng.int(10)`, `cards_drawn: rng.int(15)`, `turns: rng.int(12)`; random `TakeArtifact { take: rng.coin() }`; random pack index; `Keep` of a random `keep`-sized subset (`rng.shuffle(&cards)` truncated); `Extract` `None` or `Some(rng.int(len))`; shop: random choice of `Buy`/`RemoveCard`/`MakeRadiant`/`Buff`/`LevelArtifact` with random index, or `Leave`; campfire: `Heal`, `MakeRadiant`, `Buff`, or `RemoveCards` with two distinct random deck indices; `Choose` random option; `Bless` `None` or `Some` random offer.
8. Same file, `check_state(state, content) -> Result<(), String>`: alive (`!matches!(Won|Dead)`) implies `1 <= hp <= run_max_hp`; `Dead` implies `hp == 0`; `coins >= 0`, `tickets >= 0`; `deck.len() <= RUN_DECK_MAX`; deck ids distinct; artifact ids distinct; each artifact `1 <= level <= RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX`; blessings distinct. Each failure names itself (`"walk: hp {hp} while alive"`, `"walk: deck holds {n} past {RUN_DECK_MAX}"`, …).
9. Same file, `check_fight(state, content, engine: bool)`: `run_fight_setup` must be `Some`. Catalog walks (`engine: true`): `engine_takes(&setup)` must be `Ok` (this is the "fight starts" check; `begin_game` itself is infallible — it returns `ReduceResult` with `error: None` — so also build `create_recorded_game(&fight_options(&setup))`, run `begin_game`, and assert P1 hero health equals the setup's human `hero_health` and P1 armor equals its `hero_armor.unwrap_or(0)`). Placeholder walks (`engine: false`; pseudo cards are in no engine catalog): assert the enemy deck holds `RUN_ENEMY_DECK_SIZE` cards and `hero_health > 0`.
10. Same file, `walk(content, tag, n, engine, seen: &mut PhaseSet) -> (RunState, Vec<RunAction>)`: `run_create`, then loop until `Won`/`Dead`, panicking past `WALK_MAX_STEPS` naming tag and `n`. Each iteration: record the phase in `seen`; prove no dead end by applying `free_action` to a clone and expecting `Ok`; assert `check_state`; if `Fight`, `check_fight`; then if `rng.int(PERCENT) < WALK_WAY_ON_PERCENT` take `free_action`, else try `random_action` up to `WALK_TRIES` times via `run_reduce` and fall back to `free_action`; apply the accepted action, `check_state` again, push it to the log. Return end state and log; assert `run_fold(&RunFile { setup, unlocks, log }) == Ok(end)`.
11. Sensitivity probe (acceptance criterion 2): temporarily change `keep_count` in `lib.rs` to ignore `deck_room`, run `cargo test -p jackioh-run walk`, observe the walk test fail on an over-max deck, then revert. Report the observed failure; the revert leaves no trace.
12. Real fault found (only if a walk fails for a reason the spec does not cover): fix `lib.rs`/`fight.rs` minimally, add ruling `spec/rulings/R2979000.md` (or next free), its `proven_in` entry, a `fn r2979000_…` test, and the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/2979.md`; run `cargo jackioh spec check`. If the spec already decides it, fix with no ruling.
13. `crates/run/README.md`, Tests paragraph: append one sentence, e.g. "`src/walk_tests.rs` walks whole seeded runs on both contents, checking bounds, fight setups and replay."

## Tests

All in `crates/run/src/walk_tests.rs`; run with `cargo test -p jackioh-run walk`:

- `walks_play_whole_runs_in_bounds_start_every_fight_and_replay`: for tags `placeholder` (engine: false) and `catalog` (engine: true), `n` in `0..WALK_SEEDS`, run `walk` (includes per-step bounds, per-fight engine start on catalog, dead-end and step-bound checks, fold-to-same-state). After both loops assert every non-terminal phase (`Map`, `Fight`, `Reward`, `Pack`, `ExtractCard`, `ExtractArtifact`, `Shop`, `Campfire`, `Event`, `Shrine`) was visited at least once per content; with ~81% full-win probability per walk, `ExtractArtifact` is reached.
- `walk_bounds_fail_on_hand_built_states`: one `#[test]` per invariant, each building a `run_create`d state, breaking exactly one thing (hp 0 while alive; hp `run_max_hp + 1`; `coins = -1`; deck of `RUN_DECK_MAX + 1` distinct pool cards; deck with one id twice; artifacts with one id twice; artifact at `RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX + 1`), asserting `check_state` is `Err` mentioning the field. The over-max-deck case is the acceptance probe for criterion 2, backed by the step-11 revert-and-report run and by `r2701000_…` proving the reducer refuses the gain.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-run walk` (time it; raise/lower `WALK_SEEDS` so the whole `cargo test -p jackioh-run` stays a few seconds), then `cargo test -p jackioh-run`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` only if step 12 added a ruling.

## Done when

- [ ] Walks run in `cargo test -p jackioh-run` in a few seconds on both contents.
- [ ] A pack kept past `RUN_DECK_MAX` fails the walk (step-11 probe observed and reported; hand-built over-max test in tree).
- [ ] Every invariant has a hand-built failing state in tree (or the failure shown).
- [ ] Any real fault found is fixed, with its ruling in the 2979 block when the spec did not decide it.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant; `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.

## Risks

- Walk rng vs run rng: two streams could hide nondeterminism; avoided by fixing the walk seed per `(tag, n)` and folding only the accepted log, which must equal the end state.
- `begin_game` cannot fail: asserting on its result alone proves nothing; the plan checks `validate_setup` first, then the created game's hero health/armor.
- Catalog walks cost `register_all` + full-deck `validate_setup`/`begin_game` per fight; if seconds blow out, lower `WALK_SEEDS` before touching coverage, and say so.
- Placeholder events guarantee a zero-cost option today; `free_action` scans for it rather than hardcoding index 2, so designer content without one fails loudly instead of hanging.
- Shop visits could take many accepted steps (each buy/spend is progress); `WALK_MAX_STEPS` at 5000 only trips on a true loop.
- Purity (rule 4): only `Rng`, `run_*` functions and phase data; no banned collections, clock, or I/O; the new module falls under `crates/run/clippy.toml` automatically.

## Open questions

None. Tuning (`WALK_SEEDS`, loss/way-on rates) is a strawman the builder sets from the measured time, per §15.13.

Plan is delivered above; I recorded the observed timing (whole-run test: 0.02s) in `.bot-plan.md` to support the `WALK_SEEDS = 100` starting value.

A test module in `crates/run`, pure (its choices drawn from the engine's `Rng` on a fixed seed per walk, CLAUDE.md rule 4). For each of a named number of seeds, on both the placeholder content and the catalog's (`run_catalog_content`), it:
- picks at each phase a random action of that phase's kinds with random indices (a column, a buy, a removal, Radiant, a buff, a level, an event option, a kept subset, a blessing, leave), and reports a random fight result, mostly won at a random HP and sometimes lost, logging what was accepted;
- checks after every accepted step: HP between 1 and `run_max_hp` while the run lives, Coins and Tickets never negative, the deck within `RUN_DECK_MAX` with no card twice and no artifact twice (§15.2: nothing deals a card the deck holds; §15.3; §15.4: no run holds an artifact twice), and artifact levels within `RUN_ARTIFACT_LEVEL_MAX`;
- at every fight, builds `run_fight_setup` and checks the engine's `begin_game` starts it, curses and Combat artifacts included (R2922001);
- checks that no phase is a dead end (its free way on is accepted) and that every walk ends within a bound;
- folds the log with `run_fold` and checks it reaches the walk's end state.

## Where it lands
A new test module in `crates/run/src/`, beside `tests.rs` and `fight_tests.rs`, and `crates/run/README.md`; SPEC §15.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The walks run inside `cargo test -p jackioh-run` in a few seconds, on both contents.
- [ ] Letting a pack keep past `RUN_DECK_MAX` makes the walk test fail.
- [ ] Each invariant fails when broken on purpose, or is shown failing on a hand-built state.
- [ ] Any real fault found is fixed with its ruling in the issue's block.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

## Size and risks
Medium: one test module, 200 to 300 lines. A walk that tries random indices may rarely reach a narrow path (a shop the run can afford); weighting the picks toward actions the phase can pay for keeps coverage up. A real fault found would grow the patch.
